Commentary.Commentary: ... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

For Pakistan it was Sajid and Noman yet again as they got 8 between them but Pakistan won't be very pleased with the effort with the ball. They know they face a stiff task on a challenging wicket. They'll need to bat really well if they are going to have a chance. West Indies will hope they can repeat their bowling effort from the first innings. Stay tuned for the chase.

Kraigg Brathwaite led the way with a fifty but there were handy contributions from others too! The key for them was they had small decent partnerships which has helped them take their lead to over 250. They batted with intent and it paid off. West Indies will feel they're ahead in the game at the moment.

A fine batting effort from the Windies! It is their best effort of the series and it has come at a very good time! Pakistan will need over 250 and by how we have seen the wicket behave, this is not going to be easy.
OUT! They finally get the last wicket! On middle. Warrican steps out and looks to go over long on but holes out to Azam there!

LUNCH! So, at the stroke of Lunch, West Indies lose Alick Athanaze but have pushed the lead to 138. Really impressive from their top order who failed before this innings to make an impact. Kraigg Brathwaite came with intent and scored boundaries against all three spinners and made them vulnerable. Shan Masood shuffled his bowlers but stuck to Noman Ali from one end who scalped four wickets eventually. Sajid Khan troubled Kraigg Brathwaite twice, getting his LBW out in consecutive deliveries only to be overturned. His fifty have given West Indies a good platform. They have good depth so anything above 250 could be decisive. Can Pakistan take the remaining 5 wickets quickly? Time will tell. Stay tuned for the second session.
